name: chip
need: Filter a list, pick a few options or hold entered values as small pills

--ds-chip-height.description: a chip: the base height (size md, comfortable density) that size and density steps apply to ([options.md](options.md))

--ds-chip-padding-x.description: a chip: the base side padding, 4px per size step; next to a check, icon or glyph 8px less

--ds-chip-radius.description: a chip (at most half the height, times `--ds-shape`)

--ds-chip-check-size.description: the check of a selected chip (and the room it opens), its icon and trailing glyph: the base, 2px per size step

--ds-chip-disabled-border.description: disabled chip outline, and the container of a disabled selected chip (label and check take `--ds-disabled-ink`)

--ds-chip-disabled-bg.description: disabled chip outline, and the container of a disabled selected chip (label and check take `--ds-disabled-ink`)

--ds-chip-input-bg.description: an input chip (`.ds-chip--input`): fill, ink, edge

--ds-chip-input-color.description: an input chip (`.ds-chip--input`): fill, ink, edge

--ds-chip-input-border.description: an input chip (`.ds-chip--input`): fill, ink, edge

--ds-chip-max-width.description: the widest body of an action or input chip; its label ends in an ellipsis

width..ds-chip__body::after: the check slot of a chip: a layout size on --ds-ease-out (D29)
